action.name: fal-ai/whisper
action.searchText: whisper  whisper transcribe speech to text transcription

audio_url.description: URL of the audio file to transcribe. Supported formats: mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav or webm.
audio_url.title: Audio

chunk_level.description: Level of the chunks to return. Either none, segment or word.
chunk_level.title: Chunk Level

diarize.description: Whether to diarize the audio file. Setting to true adds costs proportional to diarization inference time.
diarize.title: Diarize

language.description:
Language of the audio file. If set to default, the language will be automatically detected.
If translate is selected as the task, the audio will be translated to English, regardless of the language selected.
language.title: Language

num_speakers.description: Number of speakers in the audio file. If not provided, the number of speakers is automatically detected.
num_speakers.title: Num Speakers

prompt.description: Prompt to use for generation. Defaults to an empty string.
prompt.title: Prompt

task.description: Task to perform on the audio file. Either transcribe or translate.
task.title: Task
